from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial result from a single company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    net_result_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Net Income', 'Net Loss', 'Net Income (Loss)')")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount as reported in the document (positive for income, negative for loss)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_start: str | None = Field(description="The start date of the reporting period")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount for verification")
    accumulated_deficit: float | None = Field(description="Accumulated deficit if reported in the document, otherwise None")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_results: list[CompanyFinancialResult]
